qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Leading global alternative asset and infrastructure manager with €195B fee-paying AUM (€354B total AUM). Thematic investment strategy backed by the Wallenberg industrial ecosystem and a proprietary network of 600+ industrial advisors. ~85%+ of FAUM in 10-12 year locked closed-end vehicles. Pricing power demonstrated by closing flagship EQT X (€22B) and Infrastructure VI (€21.5B) at their hard caps with zero fee discounts. Operating/tangible ROIC normalized at 18.3%-23.8% following BPEA integration. Primary erosion threats: macro slowdown in PE exit activity delaying performance fees, and competition in mid-market infrastructure.
